tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/cache-eviction.md <<'EOF'
# Cache eviction policy

The project's current recorded decision is that cache eviction uses LFU (least frequently used), so that frequently accessed "hot" items stay in the cache longer.
EOF
cat docs/policies/cache-eviction.md
